topics.description: 通过定向进化或理性设计改造酶的活性、选择性与新功能。
topics.en_description: Engineering enzyme activity, selectivity and new functions by directed evolution or rational design.

topics.description: 酶的三维结构、催化机理、变构调控与底物识别机制。
topics.en_description: Three-dimensional structure, catalytic mechanism, allosteric regulation and substrate recognition.

topics.key: AI 与机器学习辅助酶研究
topics.description: 用机器学习与人工智能方法辅助酶的功能预测、设计、筛选与工程化。
topics.en_description: Machine learning and AI methods for enzyme function prediction, design, screening and engineering.

topics.description: 计算酶设计、结构预测、分子动力学与 QM/MM 模拟。
topics.en_description: Computational enzyme design, structure prediction, molecular dynamics and QM/MM simulation.

topics.description: 多酶级联反应的设计、动力学协调与辅因子循环。
topics.en_description: Design, kinetic orchestration and cofactor recycling of multi-enzyme cascades.

topics.key: 酶催化方法与分析技术
topics.description: 酶催化的合成方法、分析表征技术与非天然催化反应。
topics.en_description: Synthetic methods, analytical techniques and non-natural reactions in enzyme catalysis.

topics.key: 酶固定化与酶—材料体系
topics.description: 酶的固定化策略及其与多孔材料、纳米材料、框架材料结合的体系。
topics.en_description: Enzyme immobilization and systems combining enzymes with porous, nano and framework materials.

topics.key: 酶动力学、选择性与底物特异性
topics.description: 酶动力学参数、化学/对映选择性、底物特异性与催化多功能性。
topics.en_description: Enzyme kinetics, chemo/enantioselectivity, substrate specificity and catalytic promiscuity.

topics.description: 提升酶的热稳定性、溶剂耐受性与长期储存稳定性的工程策略。
topics.en_description: Engineering strategies to improve enzyme thermostability, solvent tolerance and storage stability.

topics.description: 通过支架、限域环境或蛋白互作对多酶进行空间组织与通道化。
topics.en_description: Spatial organization and channeling of multiple enzymes via scaffolds, confinement or protein interactions.

topics.description: 从自然序列与宏基因组中发现、挖掘与表征新酶。
topics.en_description: Discovery, mining and characterization of new enzymes from natural sequences and metagenomes.

topics.description: 辅因子与辅酶的循环再生、替代物与酶促再生策略。
topics.en_description: Recycling, regeneration, surrogates and enzymatic regeneration of cofactors and coenzymes.

topics.description: 融合酶与多功能酶的设计、连接策略与级联应用。
topics.en_description: Design, linking strategies and cascade applications of fusion and multifunctional enzymes.

topics.key: 酶的应用与环境生物催化
topics.description: 面向塑料降解、污染物治理等应用与环境场景的酶催化。
topics.en_description: Enzyme catalysis for applications such as plastic degradation and pollutant remediation.
